name: Lodge and claim rental bonds
summary: Keeps the rental bond register from the property system and queues a reminder when a receipted bond's tenancy ends, so the team lodges the claim or releases the bond with the state bond authority. Lodging itself is not automated: no mapped platform can lodge a bond.

crons.name: register
crons.summary: Read tenancies and their bond receipts from VaultRE and draft one bond register row per tenancy.

crons.name: release-check
crons.summary: Queue a reminder to claim or release each receipted bond whose tenancy has ended (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a tenancy read, an Outlook draft in the bonds mailbox, a bond register row. The only send is a reminder to the team's own address, and it is queued for approval.

vaultre.covers: tenancy list and bond receipt read

microsoft-365.covers: bonds mailbox drafts and reminder sends, bond register workbook rows

gaps: Lodging, claiming and releasing a bond with a state authority (NSW Rental Bonds Online, VIC RTBA and others) is not automated: no mapped platform can do it. The reminder asks a person to do it.
Console (now Reapit PM): no kit adapter. The pages read were feature and marketing pages with no bond lodgement, claim or trust documentation. The help centre was not read.
PropertyMe: no kit adapter. Its pages cover holding deposits and trust accounts but not bond lodgement or claims. The help centre was not read.
Re-Leased: mapped with tenancy, trust account and inspection reads, but its spec has no bond field, so no adapter was built.
Rental Bonds Online (NSW) and RTBA (VIC): government portals with no API in the kit. Only the NSW landlord release page was read.
Not covered: bond top-ups, transfers and amendments, exit inspections, disputes, reconciliation against authority statements, and trust deposit allocation.
The register writes one row per tenancy. A later bond receipt does not update that row, because no workbook update operation is in the draft list.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
Both adapters are docs-only until a VaultRE sandbox and a Microsoft 365 developer tenant prove them.
